page.notes: Greek fragments on lines 3 to 6 are too faint to read letter by letter and are marked illegible. The margin numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are printed line references in the right margin; they are given as notes at their lines. The Greek on line 1 ("κατὰ τὰ") is a doubtful reading. The 25 and 30 markers fall within the lines "fecif- fent" and "Iudæi", so they are placed there as well. Catchword "respon-" is printed at the right below the last line. Printed hyphen at "de-", "Num-", "obie-" and "respon-" is kept.
